caption:
You didn't break your plan. You never had one.

What you had was an intention — trade good setups, manage risk, be patient — and intentions can't be broken because nothing in them is fixed enough to break. Here's the test: hand your rules to a stranger with your trade history. If they can't tell you which trades violated them, they were never rules.

A rule you can't break isn't strict. It's empty, and it fails silently.

Comment "MAP" for the 3T engine indicator.
